command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); `$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$cmd=[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){ Write-Output ('### '+`$p); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output -split '\r?\n'; `$m=`$o|Where-Object{`$_ -match '^ip route-static'}; if(`$m){ Write-Output (`$n+':'); `$m } } }"
